# `silence-frames/manifest.json`

**Generated by:** `scripts/export-silence-frames.ts public/projects/<slug>/source/<file>.mp4`
**Consumed by:** nothing programmatically — it's an index for the human/agent classifying `typing.json` (step 3 of the **summera-youtube-shorts** skill)

One low-res thumbnail (`f_<seconds>.png`, default 320px wide) per sampled
second across every `silenceSegments` range from `silence.json` (or across
the whole video if `silence.json` is missing), plus this manifest listing
what was sampled.

```json
[
  {"file": "f_00004.png", "timeSeconds": 4},
  {"file": "f_00005.png", "timeSeconds": 5},
  {"file": "f_00006.png", "timeSeconds": 6}
]
```

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | `string` | PNG filename in the same directory, `f_<seconds, 5-digit zero-padded>.png` |
| `timeSeconds` | `number` | whole-second timestamp the frame was pulled from |

Sampling interval, frame width, and output directory are tunable:
`export-silence-frames.ts <video> [everySec] [width] [outDir]` (defaults `1`,
`320`, `public/projects/<slug>/silence-frames`).
